brief: 글씨 크기는 기존 차 배너 정도. 다른 꽉 찬 배너도 함께 수정. 주제별 감성 서체와 여백. 배너 AI 연출 안내 삭제.

design.typography: 방한·음료·김장은 명조 계열, 간식·떡볶이는 단정한 손글씨 계열. 제목은 기존 큰 배너의 약 60%를 목표로 생성.
design.layout: 왼쪽 작은 두 줄 제목과 작은 분류명, 오른쪽 기존 사진. PC 5.5:1, 모바일 3:1. 주황색 띠 제거.

assets.prompt:
Edit the supplied existing advertisement. Keep its recognizable photographic scene, objects, material colors, natural light, steam when present, food textures and relative positions. This is a restrained Korean seasonal lifestyle banner redesign. Make the canvas landscape 3:1. Its desktop presentation is a central 5.5:1 crop, so EVERY letter and all critical object silhouettes must remain within y=25–74% of this canvas. Outside that band only background. Replace the huge heavy lettering and bright orange block completely. The replacement headline should be about 60% of the original letter height, and similar to the modest text scale of a warm tea editorial banner. Place two lines at x=9%, y=31–53%, with each glyph about 8.5% of canvas height; line spacing 1.22. Keep the headline within x=9–42%, left aligned, and leave real breathing room around it and between text and objects. Use the exact Korean wording below without new claims. A small quiet category line at x=9%, y=62–67%, glyph height 3.3%, in a readable clean medium-weight Korean sans serif, with NO colored rectangle behind it. The headline and category line occupy at most 36% of width. No extra slogan, English text, fake price, discount, logo, badge, interface controls, watermark or AI disclaimer. Do not duplicate any letters. Keep the text legible at a desktop image height of 195px. Preserve all scene objects on the right with a low horizontal arrangement; never invent packaging or change an existing package's printed product identity. Finish as one photographic bitmap, not a web screenshot.
